raw.rationale: Muscarinic acetylcholine receptor agonists such as this launched vertigo drug are not known to have cytotoxic or lineage-selective anticancer activity at 2.5 µM, and PRISM single-concentration screens of non-oncology drugs rarely show lineage-selective killing beyond base rates. Therefore probabilities are set near the low end of the stated 0.2–2.5% per-lineage base rate, with slight variation for lineages where CHRM expression or neuroendocrine/secretory biology might marginally increase sensitivity.
